items.title: SEC Charges BG Wealth and DSJ Exchange in Alleged $130 Million Crypto Fraud
items.summary: The agency says investors lost more than $100 million after the firms promised risk-free trading returns and used false filings to claim SEC approval.

items.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
items.summary: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.
